name: Sharkord
description: Sharkord is a self-hosted real-time communication platform (Discord-like) with text and WebRTC (voice/video/screen sharing). FIRST RUN: After starting the container, see the GitHub README for “Gain Owner Permissions” to claim ownership. HTTPS: Sharkord does not include built-in HTTPS. Use a reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx or Caddy) for SSL/TLS. Alpha software — expect breaking changes.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Sharkord config/data (config.ini is created on first run).

ports.name: WebRTC UDP Port
ports.description: WebRTC UDP media port. Required for voice/video/screen sharing.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container should run as (Unraid default: nobody)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container should run as (Unraid default: users)
